floorballPage.title: Floorball
floorballPage.noSeasonsForYear: No leagues found for this season year
floorballPage.archiveText: You are browsing leagues from a past season. Standings and statistics are shown on the right.

info.intro1: Be quick and reserve your spot early in the toughest floorball league in town. The 2025-2026 season follows the same format as the last couple of seasons: all licensed players are allowed regardless of league level! A team may have an unlimited number of licensed players, but a maximum of three (3) per match. The season starts with placement games, after which both the league and division championships are played!
info.intro2: Each team must name 2 referees who commit to officiating some of the season's matches. Referees are paid the standard fee (10e/match). If needed, MAHL trains the referees in the autumn.
info.intro3: The league fee also includes participation in the PMT Festival floorball tournament, held in spring 2026 at Saimaa Stadium.
info.series1: The goal is 12-16 teams. The season starts with placement games, after which teams are divided into the league and the division. The season culminates in the final games. Matches are played on Friday evenings 18-22 at the new Saimaan Portti school, which has a mat surface.
info.series2: The final league format and medal-game format depend on the number of teams. Each team plays roughly 16-24 matches during the season.
info.series3: Licensed players are allowed regardless of league level. A team may have an unlimited number of licensed players, but a maximum of three (3) per match. Goalkeepers are NOT counted as licensed players. Players under 18 are not counted as licensed players even if they play at a higher level. Women and men born in 1986 or earlier are not counted as licensed players either. Using a loan goalkeeper is allowed in MAHL floorball.
info.series4: The floorball PMT tournament is included in the team fee! The team fee includes participation in the PMT Festival tournament held in May 2026 at Saimaa Stadium. More info about the tournament in the spring.
info.loan1: For the 2025-2026 season a loan player pool is being piloted. If a team is short on players on match day, it can top up its roster with loan players so that the playing roster is 1+10 players. The team manager informs MAHL of the number of loan players needed, and MAHL arranges the loan players for the matches. MAHL invoices the loan players. More info before the season starts.
info.fee1: Participation fee 1200-2000 €, VAT 0% (the final price is confirmed once the number of teams and the league format are set).
info.fee2: Half of the team fee must be paid by the end of October 2025. The rest of the team fee must be paid by the end of January 2026.
info.fee3: The team fee includes participation in the PMT Festival floorball tournament. Teams are invoiced via Suomisport. Team managers will be contacted about invoicing at the start of the season.
